source: Read-only audit + read-only compaction simulation, 2026-07-08 (approved for implementation same day)
notes: Controlled pose/body-language rotation so nearby renders do not repeat the same stance. Deliberately modeled on lena_expression_gaze_bank_v1.json's combo/compatibility_tags shape. Each entry is a short physical-stance modifier layered on top of (never overriding) the scene bank's own 'action' field. compatibility_tags intersect against LANE_POSE_TAG_ALLOWLIST in lena_prompt_brain.py (lane-level compatibility); reference_mode_tags intersect against the slot's chosen reference_mode. 'universal' entries are allowed on every lane. hand_risk flags entries that involve a hand action, for QA/reference and for lanes with an existing hand-risk sensitivity.
